operations.comment: ; Readability scope: all currently classified source; unknown gaps stay opaque.
; Physical identities include the 16-byte iNES header. PRG is eight 16KiB pairs.
; CPU $8000..$bfff names are local to the physical bank; $c000..$ffff is fixed.
; Mapper register selections are not effective 8KiB bank identities.
; Shared scratch aliases are deliberately mechanical; scene work overlaps by callback.
; Object arrays use zero-based slots X=0..15; Entity aliases address the same
; storage with player slot zero and world-object slot+1. Display arrays have ten
; entries: four player pieces and six selected world objects. OAM is separate.
